comment: No source is published; the maker's manual is at factionoptions.com/manual. Param 0 (Unassign Peer) has no ParamWidget and so no position in the census: it is read but is driven from a custom area of the panel rather than from a knob or button, so it gets no line. The send jacks are printed IN on the panel and the receive jacks OUT, while the manual calls them SEND 1-4 and RECEIVE 1-4. Neither the send jacks nor the receive jacks are given a family: they carry whatever the two people patch. The receive slew runs at one 240th of a second (the divisor 240, once for each of the four channels). A change of more than 0.01V on a channel is what lights its activity lamp.
